The FDA keeps refrigerated food for 4 hours above 40 °F; FEMA says throw it out after 2; the Red Cross gives the temperature line but no clock at all. It asks two public records two different questions and shows the answers side by side and never added together: which papers carry a replication failure in their own title, and what a condition\'s posted trial results say about their primary outcomes. It refuses to print the two numbers this subject invites — a total count of “failed science,” and any count summed across the two records — because a title phrase is a wording its authors chose, and a p-value above 0.05 is a number the registry printed without saying whether the study was trying to show a difference or the absence of one.
